item: Stoplist review screen: candidate stopwords reviewed in batches, per language (R98)
status: shipped (draft PR; browser-walked in the sandbox)
summary: Settings > Advanced > Keywords lists candidate stopwords per language from configs/stopword_review with their evidence; accept/reject decisions live in kv_store (encrypted, ride backups); export returns the accepted words as a stopwords_extra file to commit. Platform names and ring members are refused with the reason; no hand-set kinds. No batch ships yet; the first English and French batches come from the keyword log triage.
